entities.one_line: Qatar investment and advisory firm owned by AlRayan Bank, covering asset management, sukuk and M&A advisory.
entities.summary: AlRayan Investment (ARI) is a Qatar investment and advisory firm set up in 2007 and wholly owned by AlRayan Bank. Its asset management arm runs Sharia-compliant equity, sukuk and money-market strategies, including the AlRayan GCC Fund and the QATR ETF. Its advisory arm covers IPOs, sukuk, M&A and corporate finance. It is a firm to pitch Sharia-compliant financing or advisory, not a venture fund.

rehearsal.question: How does your proposed investment meet Sharia requirements?
Why is the proposed financing route, equity or sukuk, appropriate?
What valuation, financial statements and downside protections support this transaction?
What advisory or partnership support are you actually seeking?

verification_method: Pages fetched 2026-10-11 by a plain GET (or a page-fetch tool); excerpts are verbatim and stored with each source. LinkedIn profiles that returned HTTP 999 and qinvest.com pages that failed TLS or returned 503 are marked BLOCKED_OR_UNAVAILABLE; nothing is claimed from them.
